evidence: The Jollie Brook Circuit starts and finishes off Lake Sumner Road, with the option of starting from either of the two swing bridges over the Hurunui River (approximately 3 km apart on the Lake Sumner Road).
On the river flats of the Hurunui River, a signpost marks the track that follows the true left of the Hurunui River to the Sisters car park.
Track leads up Gabriel Stream through beech forest to a low saddle then follows a side-stream to the Jollie Brook.
Cross the river via the swing bridge just below the Jollie Brook / Hurunui confluence.

doubts: This page describes one circuit that can start from either swing bridge on Lake Sumner Road. The main way is the circuit from the Jollie Brook swing bridge, since its section comes first; the same circuit from the Sisters swing bridge is recorded as W3 (loop, direction not stated). The Hope Kiwi - Jollie Brook Route has its own headings and times, so it is recorded as W2; its end, 'the swing bridge', is not named, so shape is null, and it is not clear it returns to the Jollie Brook swing bridge. The start and end swing bridges match no feature, and the two road ends on Lake Sumner Road (F1, F2) are not matched to them, so refs are null. DOC's time 18 hr 30 min and 24 km loop are not split per way, so time and distance are null. Jollie Brook Hut is not in the links and has no name entry, so its ref is null. The Cold Stream Hut route is recorded as a side trip to a hut, with no named departure place. The Jollie Brook crossing on the first leg is not said to be bridged, so no how is given.
